jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
Digital CS Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

  • Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

  • Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

  • Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

  • Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

  • Work with the onboarding squad, Content & Community, Product Marketing and RevOps so plays fit their designs and don’t clash with launches or product tours, and help decide which CS tools we build on.

Your first year

  • First 3 months: you find the first signals and set baselines together with our Data team.

  • After 4 months: your first plays for new customers are live, each running against a control group.

  • By the end of your first year: around 8 plays are live, at least 5 of them with a proven effect, and you’ve run a first pilot with an AI agent.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years driving scaled adoption or retention for a large customer base, for example in scaled or digital Customer Success, CS or Revenue Operations, lifecycle or CRM marketing, or growth, at a SaaS or subscription business.

  • Proven experience turning product usage data into health scores, signals or lifecycle triggers.

  • A track record of one-to-many programs with results you can show in numbers, including how you knew the change came from the program and not something else.

  • No need to wait for an admin: you build workflows and sequences yourself in tools like HubSpot, or Chameleon.

  • Solid SQL skills: you write and read it independently.

Nice to haves

  • You’ve built a CS program or function from scratch (0 to 1), not only taken one over.

  • Hands-on work with agent specs or AI-supported workflows in a CS or support setting, and using AI daily for writing, analysis and testing while knowing its limits: wrong answers, privacy, and when a person has to step in.

  • A background in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry.

  • Experience in Git and pull requests

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30 mins)

  • Initial conversation with the hiring manager, online (30 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture interview with the team, online (60 mins)

  • Take-home assignment (max 120 mins)

  • Final Skills interview incl. case presentation, on-site (90 mins)

jobs.title: Senior RWE Program Manager - Data/IA Expert
jobs.description:
Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous croyons en des solutions innovantes et en un environnement inclusif où collaboration et développement professionnel vont de pair.

Vous piloterez des initiatives transverses mêlant Data Science, IA, Data Engineering et Real-World Data, tout en garantissant l'alignement entre les priorités du portefeuille projets et les besoins métier.

Missions :

Program Leadership & Delivery

  • Piloter des programmes data complexes en support du développement clinique.
  • Définir les feuilles de route, jalons et livrables en cohérence avec les priorités stratégiques.
  • Assurer le suivi des risques, dépendances et échéances sur plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance ainsi que le reporting auprès des parties prenantes senior.
  • Favoriser la collaboration entre des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales.

Clinical & Data Integration

  • Faire le lien entre les équipes cliniques, scientifiques, Data Science et Data Engineering.
  • Traduire les besoins métiers et les problématiques scientifiques en solutions analytiques concrètes.
  • Accompagner l'intégration des données cliniques, RWD et autres sources de données dans les processus de recherche et développement.
  • Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la valorisation des données utilisées.

AI, Analytics & Innovation

  • Contribuer au déploiement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle et d'analytique avancée.
  • Promouvoir l'utilisation des approches data-driven dans la prise de décision clinique.
  • Participer à l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'exploitation des données et de l'IA.
  • Veiller à l'adoption des meilleures pratiques en matière d'analyse, de reproductibilité et d'industrialisation.

Stakeholder & Portfolio Management

  • Participer à la priorisation des initiatives data et digitales.
  • Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la définition des cas d'usage et de la valeur attendue.
  • Interagir avec des décideurs scientifiques, cliniques et business de haut niveau.
  • Assurer l'alignement entre les différents acteurs dans un environnement matriciel complexe.

Requirements

À propos de vous

Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant.

  • PhD, Master ou diplôme équivalent en Data Science, Biostatistiques, Informatique, Pharmacie ou Sciences de la Vie.
  • Solide expérience en gestion de projets ou programmes Data dans les Life Sciences.
  • Bonne compréhension du développement clinique et de la R&D pharmaceutique.
  • Une expérience des données de vie réelle (RWD/RWE) est un plus.
  • Connaissances en Data Science, IA et environnements de données.
  • Maîtrise ou compréhension de SQL, Python, R ou outils similaires.
  • Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes techniques et métier.

Benefits

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager:in KYC (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du willst nicht Tickets verwalten, sondern herausfinden, welches Problem sich zu lösen lohnt? Regulatorik ist für dich keine Textwüste, sondern die Landkarte, auf der du Produktchancen findest? Dann komm in unser Produktteam!

Du übernimmst im Tandem die Hauptverantwortung für KYCnow – die Plattform, mit der über 400 Banken, Versicherungen und Unternehmen ihre KYC- und KYB-Prüfungen automatisieren.

Deine Aufgaben im Produktmanagement

  • Discovery: Du führst Kunden- und Nutzerinterviews, validierst Probleme und testest Lösungsideen früh mit Prototypen
  • Markt und Wettbewerb: Du beobachtest Wettbewerber und regulatorische Entwicklungen wie die AMLR und leitest daraus Chancen ab
  • Providersteuerung: Du steuerst unsere Datenprovider und Fernident-Anbieter – fachlich wie kommerziell, von der Datenqualität bis zum Vertrag
  • Produktstrategie: Im Tandem übersetzt du die Unternehmensstrategie in Produktstrategie, Roadmap und klare Ziele
  • Impulse bewerten: Ideen aus Markt, Kundschaft, Sales und Regulatorik bewertest du nach Kundennutzen und Marktchance – und sagst auch fundiert Nein
  • Wirkung messen: Du definierst Produktmetriken und prüfst nach dem Release, ob der erwartete Nutzen eintritt
  • Zusammenarbeit: Mit Entwicklung, Design, Recht, KYC Operations, Sales und Support findest du im agilen Setup gemeinsame Lösungen – regulatorische Fragen klärst du früh und direkt


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement digitaler B2B-Produkte bzw. SaaS-Produkte, inklusive Verantwortung für Ergebnisse – nicht nur für Backlogs.
  • Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten – du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl
  • Berufserfahrung im KYC-, AML- oder RegTech-Umfeld gewünscht
  • Routine in Discovery-Methoden: Interviews, Hypothesen, Prototyping, Beta-Tests
  • Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools in der täglichen Produktarbeit; ein Gespür für KI als sinnvollen Produktbestandteil ist ein Plus
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner samt Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen von Vorteil
  • Präsentationsstärke gegenüber Kundschaft, Management und Fachbereichen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch


Das bieten wir dir

  • Geteilte Hauptverantwortung für KYCnow – mit Gestaltungsspielraum von Tag eins
  • Priorisierung nach Kundennutzen und Marktchancen statt nach interner Aufwandsverrechnung
  • Führung durch Kontext statt durch Hierarchie – kollaborativ und transparent über alle Bereiche hinweg
  • Impact: Mit deiner Arbeit hilfst du uns, Geldwäsche schwieriger zu machen.
  • Ein engagiertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, offenen Türen und einem wertschätzenden Umgang miteinander – und mit Spaß an der Arbeit.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket und Bike Leasing
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, remote deutschlandweit oder hybrid an den Standorten Frankfurt und Kassel


Über uns

Wir sind KYCnow, ein RegTech-Unternehmen mit klarem Auftrag: Wir machen KYC einfach, damit Geldwäsche schwierig wird.

Unsere Plattform unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen und Finanzdienstleister dabei, ihre Pflichten nach dem GwG effizient, automatisiert und revisionssicher zu erfüllen: von Stammdaten und UBO-Ermittlung bis hin zu Screening, Monitoring und Regular Reviews.

Wir sind ein diverses Team aus Expert:innen für Technologie, Compliance, Design und Kommunikation und arbeiten daran, komplexe Regulierung in nutzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen - für Verpflichtete, die Verantwortung tragen und Prozesse smarter machen wollen.

jobs.title: Product Manager Mission Autonomy (All Genders)
Product Manager, Enterprise Controls
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Product Manager on the Enterprise Controls team, you will empower enterprises with the tools and frameworks to govern their use of our AI Platform while ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations. Your scope will cover User Access & Identity Management (RBAC, SSO, SCIM), Framework Consistency (SDK, APIs), Audit & Compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001), and Platform Administration & Billing.

This role is critical as we’ve already secured contracts with industry leaders like ASML, CMA-CGM, and Stellantis—all of whom have rigorous IT requirements. Your work will be foundational in meeting these demands and driving the adoption of our platform at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Set the vision for Enterprise Readiness by shaping and evangelizing a product strategy aligned with company goals and market opportunities.

  • Identify gaps through market and UX research to uncover unmet needs, competitive whitespaces, and emerging trends in enterprise product management.

  • Own the product lifecycle, driving development from ideation to launch and iteration, balancing speed, quality, and user satisfaction.

  • Champion the user by partnering with design and research teams to create intuitive, high-impact experiences, refining them with data and feedback.

  • Collaborate on go-to-market strategies with marketing and sales, including pricing, positioning, and adoption plans.

  • Align stakeholders across engineering, design, and business teams around priorities, trade-offs, and timelines.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly to maintain a dynamic roadmap that delivers quick wins while advancing long-term initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience in competitive, ambiguous environments, ideally with generative AI, LLMs, or ML-driven products.

  • Technical acumen to understand trade-offs and partner effectively with engineering teams.

  • User obsession with a relentless focus on solving real problems, supported by data and qualitative insights.

  • Cross-functional influence to align and inspire teams without direct authority.

  • Problem-solving skills that balance big-picture thinking with hands-on execution, from roadmap crafting to metrics analysis.

  • Clear communication with persuasive storytelling for executives, teams, and users in docs, decks, or whiteboard sessions.

  • Adaptability to thrive in dynamic settings where priorities shift quickly.

  • Collaborative mindset with low ego and high EQ, building trust and driving decisions through clarity.

  • Autonomy to navigate unknowns and own outcomes end-to-end.

  • Growth mindset with deep familiarity in product-led growth strategies (e.g., viral loops, onboarding optimization, monetization).

  • Builder’s mindset with founder or early-stage PM experience, turning 0→1 ideas into products users love.

  • Technical depth to prototype, hack, or dive into code when needed.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Quelques chiffres

  • 230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–53k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

     

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

What you'll bring

  • Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

jobs.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

Our electronic invoicing track represents a core strategic priority for Pennylane. This dedicated team is responsible for developing our comprehensive electronic invoicing offering for our accounting firm partners and their SME clients (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), accelerating client acquisition, enhancing customer satisfaction, and establishing operational excellence within this segment.

 

As our cross-functional initiatives expand, we now require robust frameworks for end-to-end process management, data-driven performance analytics, and a relentless focus on operational efficiency and scalability. We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy & Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership.

 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

The Strategy & Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. You will help translate ambitious goals into actionable, measurable roadmaps, establish best-in-class metrics, and develop the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business rapidly and sustainably.

 

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with significant opportunity for leadership and professional growth. 

 

Your responsibilities

 

Strategic planning and execution

- Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives

- Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth

 

Data-driven decision making

- Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers

- Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research

 

Project leadership

- Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement

- Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

 

Cross-functional orchestration

- Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams impacted by the electronic invoicing reform

- Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries

 

Performance management

- Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results

- Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics

- Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them

 

Who we’re looking for

 

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments

- Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact

- Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently

 

Core competencies

- Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

- Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

- Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

- Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

- Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.

You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Antoine - General Manager RFE (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. jobs.title: Senior Business Data Scientist - Data & Transformation services
jobs.description:
Ekimetrics is a global leader in Marketing & Commercial effectiveness and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping businesses optimize marketing and operations by combining AI with business and tech expertise across 4 domains: Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.
 
With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we deliver tailor-made solutions that turn data into real positive impact, leveraging our unique combination of technology and services.
 
We excel at delivering AI impact at scale. Our mission is to harness this power to tackle the world’s most urgent issues. We commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematic AI impact at scale, and loyalty to our values and DNA. 

You join as Senior Business Scientist within our Data & AI Transformation Services (DATS). You bridge business, consulting, AI & data expertise: you frame high-value use cases, turn business needs into AI opportunities, and drive adoption. You work alongside AI, Data and Software Engineers.

Clients' Projects

  • Lead the day-to-day relationship with business and CDO/CIO sponsors, and understand their strategic and operational challenges.
  • Frame high-value Data & AI use cases and translate business needs into AI opportunities, from AI ambition and roadmap to Proof of Value and MVP.
  • Depending on the engagement, act as Data & AI Product Owner: own the product vision and backlog, prioritize with business sponsors, write and accept user stories, steer the squad's delivery with the Tech Lead from Proof of Value to MVP and production, and own the related delivery governance and planning.
  • Align business teams, leadership and ExCo around the AI roadmap and the transformation priorities.
  • Own the business value and adoption of the solutions built by the squad: operating model, usage, impact measurement, Responsible AI and governance. Challenge their feasibility and industrialization with the Tech Lead and the Tech Engineers; you do not build the models yourself, but you are technical enough to challenge and steer GenAI, LLM, agentic and ML solutions.
  • Contribute to the Transformation Cockpit: maturity measurement, adoption KPIs and steering of AI value over time.
  • Work within a multidisciplinary squad (Tech Lead, AI/Data/Software Engineers), apply Ekimetrics' DATS methods, templates and deliverables, and tailor them to each client.
  • Coordinate the business side of the squad and monitor delivery and profitability with manager support.

Strategic Projects

  • Develop and share best practices, methodologies and DATS assets (how-tos, templates, typical deliverables) across the Data & AI Transformation community.
  • Stay up to date with AI, GenAI, ML and agentic technologies, and with their impact on business models and operating models.
  • Contribute to internal AI initiatives, accelerators and thought leadership.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities for Data & AI transformation within existing client accounts (upsell and cross-sell).
  • Contribute to account development, renewals and project scoping, alongside the Partner.
  • Contribute to RFPs, proposals and pitches.
  • Support the development of new DATS offerings and use cases.

Transversal & People Development

  • Contribute to recruitment, onboarding and development of Data & AI Transformation talent.
  • Mentor and coach Junior Business Scientists and interns.
  • Develop and deliver internal AI / Data training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Profile

  • Senior level: you have already led client engagements, coordinated a team and contributed to business development.
  • Hybrid business-tech profile: you can connect business value, data, AI/GenAI, technology and adoption, and talk credibly with both sponsors and engineers.
  • Proven product ownership experience on data or AI products (backlog, prioritization, agile delivery).
  • Experience facing senior stakeholders and driving change or transformation, beyond the delivery of pilots.
Why join us?

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to lead n8n's AI Experience group: the teams that shape how people build agents and workflows with AI, how they come to trust what they've automated, and how n8n grows into a self-healing, self-improving platform.

You'll lead the PMs behind the AI Assistant, Agents and AI Trust across four areas:

Lead and grow a team of PMs

  • Lead the PMs of the AI Experience group (today AI Assistant, Agents and AI Trust), owning hiring, performance and career growth.

  • Build PMs who make strong decisions on their own, so the group doesn't depend on you or other leaders to decide.

  • Raise the bar for product craft across the group as the team and its scope grow.

Set the direction for AI Experience

  • Set a clear strategy across three themes: building great agents and workflows with AI, helping users trust their automations, and evolving n8n into a self-healing, self-improving platform.

  • Make considered bets, decide what not to do, and keep the roadmap ambitious but achievable with Engineering and Design leadership.

  • Give your teams clear missions that fit the bigger picture of n8n, and stay close to the other product groups (Capabilities, Enterprise and later Platform) as priorities shift.

Stay hands-on

  • Use the product every day, talk to the people building with it, and form your own view.

  • Co-shape work with your PMs: probe their thinking, challenge assumptions and course-correct where needed.

  • Partner with Engineering, Design and Data so the group delivers its outcomes consistently.

Improve how n8n builds products

  • Shape how PMs, designers and engineers work together in an AI-native org where engineers take on more decisions.

  • Improve product and engineering ways of working across n8n, starting with your own group.

  • Bring in go-to-market, Security, Legal, Finance, Developer Relations and model providers where decisions cross over.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • PM leadership: You've managed at least two PMs and stayed hands-on with their work, and you can point to people who got better under you.

  • Product craft: You have sharp product sense, think in systems and can turn a vague problem into something concrete.

  • AI fluency: You use AI heavily in your own work, have built something with agents (a prototype counts) and know evals and harnesses well enough to probe your PMs on them.

  • Group-level strategy: You've set direction for a product group spanning several products and teams.

  • Process mindset: You improve how product and engineering work together, and you're comfortable with engineers owning more decisions.

  • Influence without authority: You align Engineering, Design and peer groups through clarity and trust.

Nice-to-haves

  • AI products in production: You've shipped AI or agent products to real users, ideally with evals running in production.

  • Technical users: You've built for people who write code or workflows, or worked in an open-source ecosystem.

  • Startup pace: You've worked in a fast-growing, remote-first startup and enjoy the entrepreneurial side of it.

  • Org change: You've led a product team through scaling or restructuring.

  • Technical skills: You can read code, query data with SQL or prototype with agents.

Why join us?

You'll lead our AI Experience group as its first dedicated GPM, and build it from here: the PMs, the strategy and how the teams work. We're hiring you to make the calls, so most product decisions in the group will sit with you.

The problems are hard and mostly unsolved. Helping people build agents they can rely on, getting them to trust automations that run without anyone watching, and turning n8n into a platform that spots and fixes its own failures are all open questions. You'll get fast, honest feedback on every bet from a fair-code community of 115k+ members and 207k+ GitHub stars.

You'll also help work out what product leadership looks like when engineers take on more of the decisions. That's still taking shape at n8n, and you'll have a real hand in it.

We're growing fast. We hit $100M ARR in 2026, and SAP's strategic investment in May valued n8n at $5.2B, more than double our Series C valuation seven months earlier. We're aiming to build a trillion-dollar company, and AI Experience is central to getting there.

We're remote-first and async by default, and you'll work with people who care a lot about what they build and are easy to work with.

If you want to lead the AI core of n8n, we'd like to hear from you!

Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
jobs.description:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The problems you'll own

  • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

  • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

  • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

  • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

  • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

What you'll do

  • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

  • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

  • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

  • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

  • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

What you bring

  • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

  • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

  • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

  • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

  • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

  • Clear, short writing

What sets you apart

  • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

  • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

  • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

  • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

  • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

  • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

  • Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

  • Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

  • Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

  • Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

  • Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

  • Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

  • Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

  • Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

  • Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

  • Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

  • Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

  • Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

  • Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

  • Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

  • Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates

  • Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office

  • Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries

What you can look forward to:

  • A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential

  • The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work

  • A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software

  • A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Managing Assistant for our Head of Web: someone who can genuinely take work off her plate, not just coordinate it, and who is confident working directly in our web tool stack (WordPress, CMS, web tech).

This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing.

You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards.

At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction.

The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase.


What you'll do

Project Management

  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects.

  • Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery.

  • Translate client requirements into clear tasks, priorities and deliverables.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early.

  • Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches.

  • Keep clients informed about progress, next steps and upcoming milestones.

Support the Head of Web

  • Help prepare project estimates, proposals and statements of work.

  • Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting.

  • Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships.

  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and make project delivery more efficient.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Handle day-to-day client requests and coordinate their implementation with the team.

  • Ensure requests are properly documented, prioritised and assigned.

  • Follow up on outstanding client feedback, approvals and deliverables.

  • Maintain clear, friendly and professional communication with clients.

  • Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time.

Key & Essential Skills

Project Management Experience

  • Some experience running or closely supporting website projects (agency or consultancy a plus); full PM seniority is not required.

  • Ability to independently manage smaller projects while supporting larger, more complex initiatives.

  • Strong organizing skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including designers and developers.

  • Good understanding of project budgets, timelines, scope and change requests.

Technical & Digital Understanding

Communication & Organisation

  • Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues.

What makes you a fit

  • You're one step ahead. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be asked.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
