It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.


You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.

 

The opportunity

  • Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

  • Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

  • Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

  • Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

  • Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

  • Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

  • Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

  • Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

 

What you bring

  • Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

  • Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

  • Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

  • Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

  • Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

  • Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

Spotify's Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Financial Engineering (FinE) is part of Spotify's Platform Mission, sitting at the intersection of technology and finance. FinE's mission is to accelerate Spotify's growth through a trusted financial platform that delivers valuable data and insights to support the business.

As Spotify continues to scale, FinE is evolving the technology and ways of working that power our financial operations, with AI-enabled transformation creating new opportunities to improve how we work.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to join the SAFE Alliance, reporting directly to the VP of SAFE. You'll initially focus on driving AI-enabled transformation across Financial Engineering and Finance, while supporting broader technical programs and strategic initiatives across Platform as priorities evolve.

You'll bring strategic thinking, hands-on delivery expertise, and strong change leadership to navigate complexity, align stakeholders, and turn ambitious transformation goals into meaningful outcomes.


What You'll Do
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs, translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and driving execution through implementation and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive AI-enabled business transformation across Financial Engineering and Finance, partnering with key stakeholders to unlock new capabilities and fundamentally evolve how the business operates.
  • Strengthen collaboration between engineering and finance teams, aligning priorities, managing dependencies, and building shared accountability for delivery.
  • Establish and evolve effective delivery practices, including intake, prioritization, planning, roadmap alignment, and operational reviews.
  • Design and execute change management strategies that build stakeholder commitment, drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working, and embed sustainable organizational improvements.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks, blockers, and competing priorities to maintain momentum across complex initiatives.
  • Define meaningful program metrics and reporting, providing senior leadership with clear visibility into progress, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Champion continuous improvement, using data, feedback, and lessons learned to strengthen execution across FinE and the broader Platform organization.

    • Who You Are
  • An experienced Senior Program Manager with a proven track record of independently leading complex, multi-team technical programs from strategy through delivery.
  • A hands-on delivery leader who brings structure to ambiguity, drives accountability, and consistently turns plans into tangible outcomes.
  • Experienced in organizational transformation and change management, with the ability to influence adoption and embed lasting improvements.
  • Comfortable working in technical environments, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to navigate complex initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of AI technologies and their practical application in technical and business environments, with the ability to identify opportunities, navigate implementation challenges, and drive meaningful adoption.
  • Skilled at building trusted relationships across technical and business organizations, balancing competing priorities and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Experienced in establishing effective planning frameworks, delivery processes, and metrics to drive alignment and execution.
  • Curious, adaptable, and collaborative, with strong ownership and a willingness to roll up your sleeves. Experience in Finance or Financial Engineering is valuable, but not essential.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Format Foundations
jobs.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.

 

 


What You'll Do
  • Lead product vision and strategy across Spotify’s formats, shaping how books, podcasts, and music become more engaging, lovable, and valuable for users, creators, and the business.
  • Define and evolve the user experience across the content journey—from discovery and evaluation through engagement, library management, and retention.
  • Partner closely with business leaders across books, podcasts, and music to translate business strategy into product innovation that drives growth.
  • Drive innovation across multimodal and cross-format experiences, such as the intersection of listening and reading, and build capabilities that can scale from one format to others.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, data, and cross-functional partners to deliver high-quality experiences.
  • Use data, experimentation, and user insights to inform decisions and continuously improve the experience.
  • Align senior stakeholders across Core Experience, the business teams, and Personalization to create a cohesive consumer experience.
  • Lead multiple cross-functional initiatives end to end, owning scope and alignment and partnering with engineering on delivery.
  • Mentor product managers and raise the bar for product craft across the team.

    • Who You Are
  • You have 10+ years of experience in product management and have led product work across several consumer media products at scale in large technology companies.
  • You have deep knowledge of the consumer media landscape across areas such as books, podcasts, or music, including competitive dynamics, creator and publisher ecosystems, and user behavior.
  • You have experience building for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user interfaces.
  • You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that enable teams to move faster.
  • You’re able to balance user experience, technical constraints, and business impact.
  • You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences.
  • You’ve worked closely with engineering, design, and data partners to bring products to life.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity across teams and organizations.
  • You’ve influenced senior leaders and stakeholders across functions and levels to drive alignment and outcomes.
  • You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, from research and analysis to iteration and prototyping.

jobs.description:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

Comprendre & structurer la data

  • Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

  • Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

  • Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

Collaborer avec les équipes Dastra

Tu travailles notamment avec :

  • les Sales, en avant-vente, pour apporter l’expertise Data Migration nécessaire au cadrage du projet et rassurer les prospects

  • les équipes Tech, sur les problématiques d'intégration et de fonctionnement de la plateforme ; 

  • les Privacy Success Managers, pour assurer une transition fluide après la migration et transmettre les enjeux et règles métier du client. 

Le profil recherché

  • Minimum 2/3 d'expérience en gestion de projets migration clients (implémentation, migration, intégration ou transformation de données)

  • Une expérience indispensable en gestion multiprojet et multiclient, idéalement en cabinet de conseil, ESN ou environnement SaaS 

  • Une connaissance des enjeux RGPD / Privacy et du métier de DPO, acquise dans un contexte professionnel

  • Une bonne culture IT & data : mapping, structuration de données, logique de scripts, compréhension des flux et architectures 

  • Une capacité à prendre rapidement en main un nouvel outil et à comprendre son fonctionnement

  • À l'aise pour conseiller, challenger et vulgariser auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et métier 

  • Anglais C2 indispensable 

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu es curieux·se, autonome et débrouillard·e : face à un nouvel outil ou une problématique que tu ne connais pas, tu cherches, tu comprends et tu proposes.

Tu apprécies autant comprendre comment fonctionne une plateforme que piloter un projet et accompagner un client jusqu'à sa réussite.

Tu as, à minima, une expérience auprès de DPO, équipes Privacy/Compliance ou sur un logiciel GRC/Privacy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Dastra ?

  • Un rôle clé et autonome, au cœur des projets de migration clients 

  • Un poste hybride : 70 % projet & client, avec une vraie dimension data/technique 

  • Des outils innovants qui automatisent la technique pour se concentrer sur la valeur 

  • Des sujets stratégiques : Data, Privacy, RGPD et IA 

  • De l’impact et de la liberté pour proposer, améliorer et faire évoluer les pratiques

Rémunération & conditions

  • Entre 45 et 55k annuel brut, selon profil et expérience, à discuter

  • Paris 1er / Télétravail hybride (3j/2j)

  • 5 semaines de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT 

  • TR+ mutuelle d’entreprise 

  • 1 séminaire par an + des teams buildings à gogo

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification RH

  2. Entretien métier avec Mathieu, Data Migration Lead

  3. Mise en situation (en visio) avec Mathieu et Jérôme, Directeur des Opérations & Co-fondateur

  4. Échange avec les autres co-fondateurs

  5. Contrôles de références

jobs.title: Product Manager ISR & Strike
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Product Manager (ISR & Strike) at Harmattan AI, you will be at the heart of company strategy, driving the end-to-end definition, development, and delivery of our autonomous persistent ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and strike systems. You will own the evolution of our existing offer into a next-generation drone carrier platform integrated with proprietary Harmattan AI payloads. Working closely with R&D, you will translate operational needs into technical specifications, manage product configurations and versions, and ensure seamless execution from initial architecture to field deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Product Definition & Roadmap: Consolidate the existing persistent ISR offer and define the product specification and multi-version roadmap for our autonomous drone carrier and Harmattan AI payload integrations based on market analysis, customer feedback, and technological feasibility.

  • End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Own the product lifecycle from initial specification to full delivery across different system configurations, developing and maintaining timelines to ensure all milestones are met.

  • Technical & R&D Coordination: Work hand-in-hand with R&D teams to oversee system engineering, architecture, and functional development, actively resolving technical challenges across R&D and industrialization phases.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central interface between R&D, product, program, sales, and customers to align technical capabilities with operational mission requirements and ensure tender and project success.

  • Resource & Configuration Management: Manage engineering resource allocation and product configurations to deliver reliable, high-performance autonomous systems on schedule.

Candidate Requirements

  • Proven, hands-on experience within the modern DefTech ecosystem, specifically in defense products, drones/UAVs, or autonomous systems, is strictly required.

  • End-to-End Product Development: Demonstrated track record of conducting complex technical products from initial specification through R&D to final delivery and industrialization.

  • Technical & Systems Engineering Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering (Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, Robotics, or Computer Science) or a related technical field, paired with deep knowledge of system engineering, unmanned aerial systems, and autonomous payloads.

  • Customer & Mission-Oriented: Ability to translate complex ISR and strike mission requirements into concrete, scalable product features and configurations.

  • Extreme Ownership: High level of accountability and autonomy, with the drive to take full responsibility for product definition, roadmap execution, and delivery outcomes.

  • Collaborative Leadership & Active Listening: Strong communication and listening skills to build trust with R&D engineers, bridge technical and business stakeholders, and guide cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The opportunity

You work on our most strategic accounts and turn signed deals into live, revenue-generating deployments. On our largest global rollouts, successfully embedding BLP in the customer's system landscape (e.g., ERP) decides whether the go-live date holds. As a Technical Project Manager, you own the technical solution. You shape it with the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, write the specification our engineers build from, and drive internal alignment and on-time delivery.

What you'll do

  • Shape the technical solution with the customer’s business and IT departments on large and complex accounts, and push until answers are specific enough to build on.

  • Turn requirements into a clear, implementable specification for our engineers.

What you bring

  • 3+ years in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or technical product work.

  • Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer.

  • Solid understanding of how enterprise systems exchange data, from file-based interfaces to APIs.

  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • Understanding of purchase-to-pay (P2P) and order-to-cash (O2C) processes, including the related finance and accounting workflows.

Why BLP

  • A fast-growing, global AI company: the ideal place to learn and accelerate your career.

  • Employee ownership through our participation program.

Practical information

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across DACH. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and German

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: AI Architect
Product Builder Intern - Growth (Jan-Mar 2027)
jobs.description:
Your Role

As a Product Builder Intern – Growth (f/m/d), you'll take growth initiatives from first idea to live feature—working at the intersection of technology, AI, and business, and making a measurable impact in a fast-growing fintech.

We have built a state-of-the-art setup between a headless CMS (Sanity) and a Next.js website that lets product and business builders ship features fast. For you, that means rapid experimentation: form a hypothesis, build it with Cursor and Claude, put it live, and measure what it moves.

The internship will be available from January 2027 for three (3) months, and will take place at our Berlin office.

  • Build & Ship: Design, build, and launch AI-native features, conversion journeys, and landing pages on liqid.de—writing production code with Cursor and Claude, from concept to go-live.

  • SEO & AEO: Improve how LIQID is found in search engines and cited by AI assistants—through structured data, content architecture, page performance, and our knowledge hub.

  • Platform & CMS: Maintain and further develop our Sanity CMS and Next.js website—schemas, components, and templates—so that product and business teams can ship on their own.

  • Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, Design, and Engineering teams to drive initiatives forward, and share what you learn so the whole team gets faster.

What you bring

  • Background: Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, preferably with a focus on software, product, or design.

  • Builder Track Record: You have built and shipped something real—a website, app, tool, or automation—and can show it. Share a link with your application.

  • Technical Skills: You read, write, and review code with confidence—ideally JavaScript/TypeScript and React—work with Git, and use AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude every day.

  • Language Skills: Fluency in German and English.

  • Growth & Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You think in funnels, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes, and want to know why users find us and convert.

  • Curiosity & Judgment: Passion for fintech, AI, and new technology. You try new tools early, know their limits, and verify AI output before it ships—in a regulated financial product, correctness comes before speed.

  • Ownership & Initiative: Proactive and hands-on. You take ownership of features end to end, bring your own ideas, and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent communication skills. You explain technical work clearly to non-technical colleagues and build strong relationships across Product, Marketing, Design, and Engineering teams.

  • Availability: Full-time availability for minimum 3 months and the ability to travel to the LIQID HQ in Berlin (hybrid working).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Next.js, Sanity or another headless CMS, and technical SEO (structured data, Core Web Vitals).

  • Experience with LLM APIs, agents, or workflow automation.

  • Experience with Linear, Figma, product analytics, or A/B testing tools.

  • Prior experience in start-ups, consulting, or financial services.

What we offer

  • Ownership & Learning: Real exposure to product development with responsibility to make an impact. You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory.

  • Mentorship: Work with experienced Product Owners, Designers, and Engineers.

  • Flexible Work & Tools: Hybrid working options, 28 vacation days and two additional days off on December 24 and 31, high-quality equipment (MacBook, display, headphones) and a supportive environment to balance learning and work.

  • Culture & Perks: Collaborative, international, and diverse team, healthy office snacks, monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive employee benefits on investment strategies.

What happens next

  • Video interview with the Product team: A casual introduction with your future teammates to get to know each other and align expectations for the role. Some skills questions might occur.

  • Video interview with Louis: A discussion with your potential team lead to learn more about the product team, your potential projects, and how your skills and interests align with the role.

  • Offer

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applications are considered without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnic or national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal opportunity laws.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

To make all this happen, we are looking for a Marketing Manager to work closely with our Founder & CEO, Felix, and take full ownership of marketing end-to-end — shaping our positioning and messaging while driving demand generation and measurable pipeline impact. As our first dedicated marketing hire, you’ll partner closely with sales and take on a central role in driving growth and commercial success.

🎖️What success looks like

In your first month

  • You will understand our ICP, buyer personas, and create core messaging for the global market.

  • You will align closely with sales to ensure clear positioning and lead quality.

  • You will create innovative (content, tools, ect.) and highly efficient ICP based marketing campaigns.

By 3 months

  • You will measure and continuously improve MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline performance.

  • You will create and manage key marketing assets, including landing pages, case studies, and sales materials.

  • You will plan and coordinate participation in industry trade fairs, and events.

By 6 months

  • You will build and run demand generation campaigns focused on qualified leads and pipeline impact.

  • You will own PR activities / Press alongside our global terminal and feature rollouts

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

  • You bring several years of experience in B2B Enterprise SaaS marketing roles

  • You have a proven track record of driving measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

  • You bring experience in executing go-to-market initiatives, such as launching new products or entering new markets.

  • You are fluent in English and confident in communicating in professional business environments.

  • You are hands-on, pragmatic, and confident taking ownership as the first marketing hire in the company.

  • You are driven by innovative marketing approaches and continuously explore the latest trends, strategies, and growth hacks in B2B marketing.

This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 3 days per week on site.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our CEO & hiring manager, Felix.

  4. Complete a take-home case study.

  5. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia.

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across France and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and French

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Head of Website & Conversion
jobs.description:
Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 500k+ monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Head of Website & Conversion to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 500k+ visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🎁 What We Can Offer You

  • 🏥 One of the best health insurance plans on the market (Alan Blue and Alan Mind)

  • 🍜 Meal vouchers (Swile card)

  • 🏝 Between 6 and 12 additional RTT days on top of 5 weeks of paid leave

  • 🧑‍💻 A dedicated monthly budget for all Pennylaners to support working from home or from a coworking space

  • 🏢 Easy access to our offices, located a few minutes from Saint-Lazare in the heart of Paris

  • 💵 A BSPCE (employee equity warrants) package

  • 🏃‍♀️ Access to 8,000 gyms across France and over 300 wellness activities through our partner Gymlib

  • 💻 A Mac

  • 🎉 We play a lot of sports together and care about getting everyone together regularly at company events, such as the Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) and our annual company seminar, which creates great moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

To thrive at Pennylane, you will need to:

  • Speak English (the level is assessed and valued according to the department you are applying to)

  • Enjoy working in a constantly changing environment

  • Make collaboration a priority within your team and with other stakeholders

  • Have enough perspective to prioritize high-business-impact actions in your day-to-day work

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so.   • Lead complex AI discovery

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Le poste

En tant que Support Operations Specialist, tu rejoindras la Team Customer Success & Delivery. Véritable point de contact de nos clients, tu les accompagneras dans l'utilisation de notre solution en assurant le traitement, le suivi et la résolution de leurs demandes. Tu auras aussi un rôle clé dans le pilotage de l'activité support, en interne comme auprès des clients.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Qualifier et traiter les demandes entrantes (outil de ticketing, e-mail) dans le respect des SLA (anomalies, demandes de support utilisateur, demandes d'évolution, demandes de travaux).

  • Vérifier la complétude des tickets (informations nécessaires, pièces jointes, contexte).

  • Réaliser le diagnostic des incidents (N1/N2) afin de déterminer la nature du besoin.

  • Prendre en charge et résoudre les demandes ne nécessitant ni paramétrage technique ni développement informatique.

  • Assurer la résolution des incidents ou leur escalade vers les équipes Produit ou Tech si nécessaire, en garantissant un transfert clair et documenté.

  • Assurer le suivi des demandes de bout en bout, informer régulièrement les clients et documenter chaque étape.

  • Veiller au respect des niveaux de service (SLA) et relancer les équipes de niveau 2 et 3 si nécessaire.

  • Formaliser la base de connaissances (FAQ, guides, tutoriels) et structurer les macros de réponse.

  • Participer aux tests et aux recettes des nouvelles versions et remonter les retours clients pertinents à l'équipe Produit.

  • Piloter l'activité support : prioriser et suivre les tickets de l'équipe, assurer le reporting et proposer des plans d'amélioration.

  • Animer les points réguliers avec certains clients (mensuels, trimestriels ou annuels) pour présenter le bilan du support sur la période.

Les outils et environnements de travail :

  • Utilisation basique de Base de données (via phpMyAdmin).

  • Maîtrise de Mantis (gestion des tickets).

  • Utilisation de base documentaire et procédures internes.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu es diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 (informatique de gestion, gestion de projet, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent).

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en support logiciel B2B, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS, avec une vraie dimension pilotage : priorisation et suivi des tickets, reporting, actions d'amélioration.

  • Tu as déjà animé des points réguliers avec des clients.

  • Tu comprends les environnements SaaS (web et mobile), tu possèdes des notions d'API et de SSO, et tu sais réaliser des requêtes SQL simples.

  • Tu fais preuve d'un bon esprit d'analyse, de rigueur et de méthode pour diagnostiquer, qualifier et suivre les demandes.

  • Tu sais prioriser tes activités et gérer plusieurs sollicitations en parallèle.

  • Tu as un excellent sens du service client et tu apprécies d'accompagner les utilisateurs dans la recherche de solutions.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme fonctionnels.

  • Tu es organisé(e), réactif(ve) et animé(e) par une démarche d'amélioration continue.

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu parles anglais.

  • Tu as déjà participé à la création ou à la mise en place d'une FAQ.

  • Tu connais les écosystèmes ERP ou SIRH.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Une équipe expérimentée, bienveillante et toujours prête à partager ses connaissances.

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  • Seconde mise en situation : l’objectif est d’évaluer les capacités rédactionnelles.

  • Échange avec le Team Lead – Projet, la Head of Delivery et le Project Manager.

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour de télétravail par semaine. Les 3 premiers mois, une présence quotidienne sur site est demandée pour faciliter ton intégration.

Rémunération : 34k à 36k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

jobs.title: Program Manager, Office of the Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.

You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

In this role you will

  • Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods.

  • Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

  • Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

  • Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

  • Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week.

  • Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one.

What This Role Is Not

You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so.

Who You Are

You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up.


You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands.

What You Bring

  • 8 to 10 years running cross-team program execution in digital commerce, technology product management, consumer facing technology, with an earlier career in management consulting.

  • You have owned outcomes across teams without owning the teams. Titles vary — program manager, strategy manager, operations lead, product operations — but the pattern is the same: you were accountable for work you moved through people who did not report to you.

  • Fluent in product work: you know how discovery, design and shipping actually run, and you can talk to designers and engineers without a translator.

  • Comfortable with data and tools: you build a clean portfolio view and a tracking system people trust, and you use AI to do the assembly faster than most.

  • Experience working closely with senior leaders, ideally from an executive office or chief-of-staff environment; experience inside a larger corporate group around a small, fast team is a real advantage.

  • Comfortable at both altitudes: you can run a room of executives in the morning and fix the tracking sheet in the afternoon.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Not a classic PMO profile. We want someone who clears the path, not someone who produces process.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. Be part of a dynamic ecosystem of tech-led companies across markets, from emerging disruptors to established platforms, all working to create positive change at scale.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through high-stakes challenges within our diverse portfolio. You will gain access to a network of businesses, leaders, and learning opportunities that span continents and industries.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and bold ideas. You will operate at the intersection of venture-building, innovation, and investment, where experimentation is encouraged and cross-company collaboration drives breakthroughs.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. We challenge assumptions, explore new frontiers, and believe great ideas can come from anywhere in our ecosystem.

  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive, outcome-driven workspace. You will work alongside sharp, motivated peers across our portfolio, all united by a shared ambition to move the needle.

  • Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.
