jobs.title: Commissions & Targets Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Commissions & Targets Manager to own how our sales organisation is paid and how its targets are set. You'll run the commission process end to end, manage CaptivateIQ, handle complex cases, and run the quarterly target distribution for our sales reps. You'll shape our commission strategy with the Director of Revenue Operations.

You'll also be the go-to person for two experienced commission analysts. It's not a line management role, but you'll guide the team on difficult cases. Payouts depend on accurate numbers delivered on fixed deadlines, so we need someone with strong attention to detail who prioritises well in a fast-moving team.

This is an Individual Contributor role.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Master our commission plans, workflows, and CaptivateIQ setup, and execute your first end-of-quarter close with support from the Director.

  • First 6 months: Take full ownership of the end-of-quarter close and case escalations, and lead your first quarterly target distribution.

  • First 12 months: Partner with the Director to shape our commission strategy while optimising the processes and system configurations you inherited.


What Will You Be Doing?

Commission Processes

  • Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters.

  • Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results.

  • During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable.

  • Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source.

Commission Cases & Team Support

  • Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts.

  • Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions.

  • Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication.

Commission System Ownership

  • Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access.

  • Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes.

  • Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible.

Commission Strategy

  • Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals.

  • Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change.

  • Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders.

Quarterly Target Distribution

  • Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders.

  • Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published.

  • Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Hands-on experience running commission processes for a quota-carrying sales organisation, including end-of-quarter closes.

  • Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines.

  • A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source.

  • Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus.

  • Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs.

  • Experience guiding or coaching other analysts.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

  • Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus.

What We Offer?

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
jobs.description:
Over Noldus

Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers

wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen

worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot

ziekenhuizen en bedrijven.

We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons

beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige

stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en

aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen.

De stageopdracht

Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en

overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers?

Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe

videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team

bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste

kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je

zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

• Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke

mogelijkheden ze bieden.

• Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je

functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien.

• Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke

waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek.

• Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of

functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen.

• Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om

bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot

eindproduct.

• Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de

grootste kansen liggen.

• Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning.

• Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in

gebruik.

• Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt.

• Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe

huisstijl.

• Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en

andere digitale kanalen.

Wat willen we bereiken?

Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent

die:

• Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert.

• Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden

gebruikt.

• Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl.

• Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet.

Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de

toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief.

• De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven.

• Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten.

• Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving.

• Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale

kanalen.

• Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties

en softwaredemo’s.

Het eindresultaat

Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe

standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren.

Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar!


Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in

professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative

Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare

creatieve opleiding.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

• Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling.

• Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of

vergelijkbare software.

• Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren.

• Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op.

• Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker

kan.

• Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit

te leggen.

Ervaring met animatie of motion graphics is een pluspunt.

jobs.title: Payments Pricing Lead
jobs.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

Everfield Payments are an ambitious and innovative embedded payments business working inside a company that buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our intention is to transform the way Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) integrate payment acceptance into their solutions. With a small but rapidly growing team, we are focused on delivering exceptional, scalable payment solutions tailored to the needs of the European market.

About the Role

As Payments Pricing Lead you own pricing for Everfield Payments end-to-end: the strategy, the policy, the tooling behind it and the way our business units put it into practice. This is a build role.

Most of our business units are new to selling payments. A large part of this job is enablement: getting their commercial teams and leadership comfortable with payments economics so they can sell profitably. You will work closely with Proposition, Sales/GTM, Finance and our development team, and we expect you to bring your own view rather than wait to be asked for one.

You will be one person serving a growing number of business units, so using AI to scale yourself is part of the job rather than a nice extra.

This is a hands-on role for a key individual contributor.

What you will do:

  • Work with relevant stakeholders on input costs, reconciliation and how margin lands in the P&L, and with Sales/GTM so market feedback reaches the relevant sales enablement tools and strategies

  • Design and own Everfield's payments pricing strategy enabling Business Unit’s sales teams to win payments business at the right margin. Develop discount and incentive strategies and structures for payments and payments hardware

  • Develop and implement a margin management process, including regular profitability monitoring, which can be delivered across regions and PortCo's

  • Manage process of re-pricing and monitoring back-book customers

  • Own the requirements for our enablement tooling and work with our development team to ship it.

  • Run profitability monitoring across business units and markets, and lead the re-pricing of back-book merchants where margins are too low

  • Develop pro-active strategies to re-price merchants as part of the growth strategy

  • Support Business Units to win complex deals, RfP’s and negotiations

  • Enable and coach business units to sell payments profitably. Most are new to payments, so expect to run training, build playbooks and templates, and develop local champions.

Who We Are Looking For:

  • Proven capability to operate effectively at all levels and gain the confidence of colleagues and senior management

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of payments economics: interchange, scheme fees, IC++ versus blended. You spot the opportunities in a cost overview and are up to date with pricing strategies of the competition

  • AI native. You already use AI tools to be more efficient and enhance your contribution

  • Significant experience in a commercial pricing role within a high transaction volume business, ideally in payments

  • Able to explain payments economics clearly to people who do not know payments. Much of this role is teaching commercial teams who are new to the industry

  • Self-directed. You will set the agenda for this function rather than receive it, and we expect proposals to come from you

Desirable experience:

  • Experience pricing across several European markets with different competitive dynamics

  • Experience in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up environment

  • Comfort with data tools (SQL, Tableau, Power BI or similar)

What We Offer:

  • Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

  • Remote Flexibility (Can be based in the UK/Spain/Holland/Germany/Poland/France)

  • A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

  • Benefit from access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem — accelerate your personal and professional growth.

  • Regular team events and company celebrations.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

jobs.title: Application Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data.
Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.
 
Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.
 
You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :
Insights about Outsight
 
Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience.  We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.
Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.
 
 
Position Overview :
 
Outsight operates a Hybrid SaaS architecture and is shifting its operational focus from infrastructure-heavy systems support to application-level support. In this role, you maintain the daily stability of live customer deployments. You will isolate software incidents, parse application logs, and escalate verified product defects to the L2 Customer Engineering team. This position requires participating in a scheduled night and weekend on-call rotation.
 
What will be your responsibilities? 
 

  • Operational Handover: Validate that new customer deployments meet documentation, alert thresholds, and tracking metric standards before accepting operational ownership from Field Application Engineers (FAEs).

  • Technical Triaging: Triage incoming tickets, reproduce application defects in test environments, and escalate unresolved software issues to L2 engineering with targeted log data.

  • Production Operations: Execute scheduled configuration changes, system health audits, and remote software updates on live production environments.

  • Documentation: Write and maintain internal runbooks and technical troubleshooting guides to standardize incident resolution workflows.

  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Reconstruct incident timelines and extract log data to submit bug reports to Product and Engineering teams.

 
What are the requirements for the role? 
 

  • Experience: 3+ years supporting live production software environments within technical support, system administration, deployment engineering, or site reliability engineering (SRE).

  • Linux Skills: Direct experience with Linux/Unix command-line navigation, system administration utilities, log parsing, and remote diagnostics.

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Experience navigating hybrid environments combining physical hardware, TCP/IP networking (DNS, VPNs, firewalls, VLANs), and cloud services.

  • Incident Communication: Experience providing technical timelines and status updates to internal stakeholders during critical incidents.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in English. French language proficiency is an asset.

  • Flexibility: Availability to participate in a scheduled night and weekend on-call rotation.

  • Preferred Qualifications: Hands-on experience with Bash, Python, SQL, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana, or Prometheus. Background in IoT, edge computing, or computer vision environments.

 
Why join us?
 

Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.

As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.

Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.

Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

Outsight also strives for a healthy and safe workplace, and prohibits harassment of any kind. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Today, our technology is the world's earliest commercially available in-ovo sex determination and is already running in live production. As a B2B company, we work directly with hatcheries, and our focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. Beyond this first application, our platform enables non-invasive material analysis across biological and industrial environments, from agriculture to food production and beyond.

We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Commissions & Targets Manager to own how our sales organisation is paid and how its targets are set. You'll run the commission process end to end, manage CaptivateIQ, handle complex cases, and run the quarterly target distribution for our sales reps. You'll shape our commission strategy with the Director of Revenue Operations.

You'll also be the go-to person for two experienced commission analysts. It's not a line management role, but you'll guide the team on difficult cases. Payouts depend on accurate numbers delivered on fixed deadlines, so we need someone with strong attention to detail who prioritises well in a fast-moving team.

This is an Individual Contributor role.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Master our commission plans, workflows, and CaptivateIQ setup, and execute your first end-of-quarter close with support from the Director.

  • First 6 months: Take full ownership of the end-of-quarter close and case escalations, and lead your first quarterly target distribution.

  • First 12 months: Partner with the Director to shape our commission strategy while optimising the processes and system configurations you inherited.


What Will You Be Doing?

Commission Processes

  • Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters.

  • Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results.

  • During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable.

  • Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source.

Commission Cases & Team Support

  • Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts.

  • Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions.

  • Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication.

Commission System Ownership

  • Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access.

  • Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes.

  • Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible.

Commission Strategy

  • Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals.

  • Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change.

  • Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders.

Quarterly Target Distribution

  • Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders.

  • Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published.

  • Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Hands-on experience running commission processes for a quota-carrying sales organisation, including end-of-quarter closes.

  • Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines.

  • A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source.

  • Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus.

  • Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs.

  • Experience guiding or coaching other analysts.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

  • Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus.

What We Offer?

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Who we are

We're Jobtome (https://weare.jobtome.com/) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale.

Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now.

The role

You'll join our engineering team as a Senior Go Backend Developer and take real ownership of critical backend systems and services — not ticket-pushing, actual ownership.

You'll design, build, and evolve the backend services that power our products, weigh in on architectural decisions, improve system reliability, and help shape how backend engineering is done across the company.

This is a hands-on senior role: you'll write production Go every day and be deeply involved in technical decisions that have real impact.


Quick reminder before the details

5+ years of production Go experience — required Based in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3)

What you'll do

  • Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, and system resilience

  • Actively tackle refactoring, technical debt, and long-term improvements

  • Own backend features end to end, from design to production

  • Take part in Agile ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives)

Our stack

Go sits at the center of everything. Around it, you'll work with (and should be comfortable with):

  • API design (GraphQL and/or REST)

  • PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases)

  • BigQuery and other NoSQL databases

  • Distributed systems and service-oriented architectures

  • Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab pipelines preferred)

  • A cloud-infrastructure mindset (GCP or other providers)

  • Kubernetes

Nice to have:

  • Working experience with Python

What "senior" means to us

Titles vary — here's what we actually mean. A senior engineer at Jobtome can:

Bei virtual7 verbinden wir unsere technologische Expertise mit einem tiefen Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Durch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen schaffen wir einen echten Mehrwert für unsere Rahmenvertragspartner in der öffentlichen Verwaltung.   • Arbeitsmix: 90% Remote (nur in Deutschland möglich)

DEINE MISSION

Im Projekt geht es darum, eine sichere Software Supply Chain für eine hochsichere, physisch isolierte Multi-Cloud-Plattform (Air-gapped) im öffentlichen Sektor weiterzuentwickeln. Ziel des Projekts ist es, den automatisierten, sicheren und nachvollziehbaren Transfer von Software-Artefakten aus externen Quellen in isolierte Cloud-Umgebungen zu ermöglichen.

  • Verarbeitung unterschiedlicher Artefaktformate (OCI Container Images, Helm Charts, ISO-Images, Archive und Binärdateien)

  • Sicherstellung der Artefakt-Integrität durch kryptografische Prüfsummen und Signaturen (z. B. Cosign)

  • Bündelung, Kompression und Vorbereitung von Artefakten für den Air-Gap-Transfer (z. B. OCI, TAR, OCM)

  • Betrieb einer skalierbaren, mandantenfähigen Artefakt-Registry-Infrastruktur auf Kubernetes

  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von Kubernetes-Operatoren in Go (Golang) und API Extensions zur automatisierten Beschaffung, Verwaltung und Prüfung von Artefakten

MUST-HAVES FÜR DIESE POSITION

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Go (Golang), Python und der Entwicklung von Kubernetes-Operatoren

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich DevOps oder DevSecOps, insbesondere im Aufbau und in der Nutzung von CI/CD-Pipelines

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Kubernetes-Umgebungen

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Linux, Automatisierung und Scripting

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (IaC) und GitOps

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit SDLC, Codeversionierung und Git

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Ceph, Rook und Object Storage

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Betrieb von OCI-Registries auf Kubernetes (z. B. Harbor, Nexus Repository, Artifactory, Zot)

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Artefakt-Signierung, kryptografischen Hashes (SHA-256/512) und Provenance (Herkunftsnachweis)

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit SBOMs (Software Bill of Materials) und automatisierten Security-Scannern (z. B. Falco)

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Dokumentation von User Stories und Features in Jira

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden (Scrum oder Kanban)

Nice to have:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der resilienten Verarbeitung von Großdateien über 10 GB (Multipart-Downloads, Chunking, Resume-Mechanismen und On-the-fly-Prüfsummenvalidierung)

DEIN NEUER PROJEKTEINSATZ

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Grow Into Forecasting

  • Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation.

  • Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call.

  • The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly.


What We Offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

The mission

You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites.

Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer, you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites.

You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management.

Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

  • Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends.

  • Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root-cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions.

  • Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready.

  • Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1–L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR.

  • Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere.

  • Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen.

 

About you

  • 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands-on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred).

  • End-to-end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to escalate.

  • Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root-cause analysis.

  • Deployment experience: you've taken racks from delivery to production, with concrete examples to show for it.

  • Vendor fluency: you've managed hardware vendors — RMAs, field replacements, escalations — to concrete outcomes.

  • Impeccable safety and discipline: ESD/LOTO/PPE without exception; clean, labeled, auditable work.

  • Communication & mentoring: clear status updates and handovers; able to coach engineers during live incidents with composure.

  • Mobility: willing to visit our other sites in the Paris region as needed.

 

Nice to have

  • GPU-dense platform experience: NVIDIA H-series (H100/H200) or GB-series rack deployments.

  • High-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), RAID/storage (NVMe/SAS/SATA), vendor tooling (iDRAC/iLO/IPMI).

  • Automation (Python/Bash) for ops tooling and reporting; ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory/RMA flows.

jobs.title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
jobs.description:
Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales

Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi

Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.).

Contexte et missions

Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale.

Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales.

Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins.

Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI.

Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème.

Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré.

L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet.

État de l’art

Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3]

De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5]

Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins.

Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7].

Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires.

Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales.

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe.

Compétences attendues :

  • Formalisation de problèmes complexes (PL, PLNE)

  • Compétences solides en algorithmique et programmation (de préférence Python)

  • Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais pour la documentation et la communication des résultats

Modalités

Date de début : à partir de février 2027 (flexible)

Durée : 5-6 mois

Laboratoire : Centre Génie Industriel, IMT Mines Albi.

Lieu : Albi

Contact

Pour toute question concernant le stage, contactez Cléa Martinez ----- candidater, envoyez votre CV, lettre de motivation, et notes de master à Cléa Martinez (

Références

[1] M. Barlet, « L’Accessibilité potentielle localisée (APL) : une nouvelle mesure de l’accessibilité aux soins appliquée aux médecins généralistes libéraux en France », Etudes et recherche 124, 2012.

[En ligne]. Disponible sur: https://drees.solidarites-sante.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/2020-10/dter124.pdf

[2] C. S. ReVelle, H. A. Eiselt, et M. S. Daskin, « A bibliography for some fundamental problem categories in discrete location science », European Journal of Operational Research, vol. 184, no 3, p. 817‑848, févr. 2008, doi: 10.1016/j.ejor.2006.12.044.

[3] Z. Drezner et H. W. Hamacher, Facility Location: Applications and Theory. Springer Science & Business Media, 2004.

[4] W. Gu, X. Wang, et S. E. McGregor, « Optimization of preventive health care facility locations », Int J Health Geogr, vol. 9, no 1, p. 17, mars 2010, doi: 10.1186/1476-072X-9-17.

[5] A. Ahmadi-Javid, P. Seyedi, et S. S. Syam, « A survey of healthcare facility location », Computers & Operations Research, vol. 79, p. 223‑263, mars 2017, doi: 10.1016/j.cor.2016.05.018.

[6] J. Kalcsics et R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, « Districting Problems », in Location Science, G. Laporte, S. Nickel, et F. Saldanha da Gama, Éd., Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2019, p. 705‑743. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-32177-2_25.

[7] S. Yanık et B. Bozkaya, « A Review of Districting Problems in Health Care », in Optimal Districting and Territory Design, R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, Éd., in International Series in Operations Research & Management Science. , Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2020, p. 31‑55. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-34312-5_3.

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

As DTACT’s first BDM, you’ll grow our business across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg through system integrators and other integrator partners, shaping how the function is designed and scaled. Reporting to the Head of Sales BENELUX & South, you’ll work closely with Customer Experience, Product and Pre-sales to make every joint deal a success, with plenty of room to run your own agenda.

We’re looking for an enterprising, resourceful self-starter who treats every result as their own and flourishes with real independence. You’re a relationship builder with strong commercial drive who understands how integrators make money and how their sales and delivery teams work. You earn trust quickly with partner leaders and technical teams alike, you’re comfortable working across cultures and languages in BENELUX, and you pair a collaborative attitude with the discipline to hit your number. If you’d rather build something than step into something, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of BENELUX integrator partners and be their first point of contact at DTACT.

  • Build and execute joint business plans with clear targets for pipeline, revenue, enablement and customer wins.

  • Identify, qualify and recruit new integrator partners that fit DTACT's market and strategy.

  • Own and accurately forecast the partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue for your portfolio.

  • Co-sell with partners: join customer meetings, support proposals, build joint pipeline and drive complex deals to close, applying deal registration, pricing and margin rules consistently.

  • Keep the CRM accurate, report on pipeline and partner performance, and bring partner feedback to Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What you'll bring

  • A proven track record of meeting revenue targets through partners and building joint business plans.

  • An existing network or strong knowledge of system integrators and IT partners in BENELUX.

  • Enough technical understanding to hold credible conversations with partner engineers.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Proactive, hands on approach. Does not need close supervision.

  • Professional English and Dutch; German is a strong plus.

  • Nice to have: experience in cybersecurity, AI or data; building partner programs; or public-sector and tender sales.

What's in for you

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.


What You'll Build & Own

  • On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

  • Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

  • Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

  • Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

  • AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.

What You Bring

  • Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system.

  • Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns.

  • Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end.

  • AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.

✨ Why join us?

  • 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance)

  • 📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: it's not just about shares, it's about shared success.

  • 🏋️ Urban Sports Club Membership

  • 🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches

  • 🎯 Purpose with Impact: shape how the world hydrates while wiping out single-use plastics.

  • 📋 Scale-up pace means fresh challenges (and new skills) every quarter.

  • 🤝 Join an ambitious, bold, and fun crew that's always got your back.

  • 🌱 Company-sponsored gym membership keeps mind and body in sync.

  • 💰 Pension plan with Zwitserleven (50/50 split) so you grow while your savings do, too.
