Make Cosuno the leading digital authority in the construction industry.

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're transforming one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries through technology, proprietary data and artificial intelligence.

As our Organic Growth & Content Manager, you'll make Cosuno impossible to overlook, wherever our customers search, learn and form opinions. From Google and AI assistants to industry publications, social media and professional networks, you'll establish Cosuno as a trusted source of knowledge and innovation.

You'll own our organic growth and content strategy, turning our unique market data, customer expertise and technological innovation into a competitive advantage. Your ambition goes beyond generating traffic: you'll build industry authority, create demand and turn visibility into measurable business growth.

You'll join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, our website relaunch, and become one of the first members of a growing marketing team, with significant freedom to shape how we operate.

  • Content strategy & editorial direction: Develop a unified content strategy informed by customer needs, search demand, industry trends and commercial priorities.

  • Customer references & storytelling: Build a strong portfolio of customer success stories, case studies and testimonials that demonstrate measurable value and strengthen credibility.

  • Content distribution: Build a scalable content ecosystem that repurposes and distributes content across our website, blog, LinkedIn, newsletters, trade media, partner channels and sales enablement.

  • On-site SEO: Own our organic website performance, including technical SEO, content architecture, landing pages, Marketplace pages and programmatic SEO.

  • Website relaunch: Own the SEO strategy, requirements and migration alongside our website agency, turning the relaunch into a significant organic growth opportunity.

Build a scalable organic growth engine

  • AI-powered execution: Work with our GTM & Growth Engineer to automate research, content production, optimization, distribution and reporting without compromising quality.

  • Experimentation: Explore new content formats, data-driven landing pages, interactive tools and distribution opportunities. Scale what generates measurable results.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation and industry experts to ensure content creates value across the entire customer journey.

  • Performance & measurement: Track organic visibility, AI search presence, engagement, qualified sign-ups, demo requests and pipeline contribution.

Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you'll also oversee our organic LinkedIn presence and founder communications, establishing the editorial foundations for future collaboration.

What you bring

We're looking for someone who combines the analytical mindset of a growth marketer with the editorial judgment of a content strategist.

  • Organic growth expertise: You've owned SEO and content strategy in B2B SaaS or a digital marketplace, with measurable impact on acquisition or pipeline.

  • Strong SEO fundamentals: You're experienced in technical, on-page and off-page SEO, including website migrations and scalable content architectures.

  • AI search expertise: You understand GEO, AEO and the role of external sources, brand authority and structured content in AI-generated recommendations.

  • Content strategy experience: You've built editorial strategies across formats and channels, including thought leadership, customer stories and research-led content.

  • Editorial excellence: You write exceptional German, develop compelling narratives and know how to turn complex topics and proprietary data into accessible, authoritative content.

  • Distribution mindset: You understand that great content is only valuable if it reaches the right audience. You're comfortable building media relationships and content partnerships.

  • Analytical mindset: You're proficient in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar tools and measure success beyond traffic and rankings.

  • AI-first mentality: You leverage AI and automation to increase output and quality, rather than relying on manual execution.

  • Ownership: You're proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build a function from the ground up.

  • Native-level German and fluent English.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: Build our organic growth and content function from the ground up, including our upcoming website relaunch.

  • Unique data and stories: Access proprietary construction market data and industry expertise with the potential to set the agenda for an entire industry.

  • AI at the core: Work with the latest AI technologies and dedicated engineering support to bring ambitious ideas to life.

  • Competitive compensation: Above-market salary and a permanent contract in a stable, well-funded technology company.

  • A great team: An ambitious, international team with regular off-sites, team events and an open feedback culture.

About Cosuno

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, yet much of it still runs on fragmented information, spreadsheets and manual processes.

We're changing that.

Cosuno combines an intelligent marketplace, proprietary industry data and artificial intelligence to transform how construction companies find partners, manage tenders and award contracts.

Join us and help shape the voice of the future of construction.

Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.
 
Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.
 
You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :
Insights about Outsight
 
Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience.  We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.
Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.
 
 
 
Position Overview :
 
As a Field Deployed Engineer in the Customer Delivery team, you are the customer's privileged point of contact for all aspects related to the deployment of our “Spatial Intelligence Platform” solutions intended for managers of public places (Airports, etc.) and “Real-time 3D perception” for developers of smart machines and systems (robotics, real-time mapping, automatic pilots, aerial inspection, etc.)
 
What will be your responsibilities? 
 
Serve as the primary technical contact for deploying our solutions in public spaces and smart infrastructures.
 
Lead product installations and manage customer feedback, ensuring a seamless experience from start to finish.
 
Analyze and resolve technical issues, contributing to product improvement.
 
Ensure customer Satisfaction. Develop and deliver training materials that help customers get the most out of the company's products and services.
 
Deliver onboarding training to new customers to help customers understand and adopt Outsight solutions.
 
Generate new sales opportunities: Identify the right stakeholders in the existing customer portfolio, provide insights on customer needs and upcoming projects to the sales team.
 
Help close deals by answering customer questions and addressing any concerns, delivering demo of Outsight solutions and attending to pre-sales customer meetings when requested.
 
Collaborate with other teams: Work closely with other teams, such as sales, marketing, and product development. Provide valuable input on product features, marketing campaigns, and customer support initiatives, and in particular document Feature Requests (tagged as sales or delivery blockers).
 
What are the requirements for the role? 
 
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Industrial, Automotive, or Mechanical Engineering—or equivalent practical experience.
 
Minimum 3 years in a similar role, demonstrating effective project ownership, client-facing support, and technical engagement.
 
Proficient in Linux systems with the ability to independently deploy, configure, and troubleshoot software solutions in real-world environments.
 
Strong problem-solving mindset and autonomous troubleshooting skills, especially in undocumented or fast-changing situations.
 
Clear communicator with the ability to simplify and explain complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Solid IT and networking fundamentals (e.g., routing, firewalls, TCP/IP).
 
Fluent in English (French is a plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced, collaborative startup setting.
Willing and able to travel for on-site deployments and client support.
 
Why join us?
 
Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.
 
As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.
 
Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.
 
Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern - Events & Community
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 

The Opportunity 

As our Marketing Intern for Events & Community, you will gain hands-on experience in how a B2B deep-tech company turns marketing initiatives into real-world pipeline. Working closely with our Marketing Campaign & Operations Specialist and the wider Growth team, you will learn how to coordinate industry events, support our social channels, and assist in managing branded touchpoints. This internship is designed to give you deep insights into campaigns, events, social media, and CRM in a fast-paced environment, providing you with a strong foundation for your future career in marketing while you support real projects under the guidance of experienced professionals.

 

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics builds the autonomous workforce for the global process industry. Founded in 2016 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we design, manufacture and operate ANYmal, a legged robot for industrial inspection, together with the Data Navigator industrial AI platform. Our robots work at more than 250 industrial sites for 50+ customers across five continents, in oil and gas, chemicals, power, metals and other process industries. About 200 people from around 30 nationalities work at our headquarters in Zurich and our offices in San Francisco and Barcelona.


Your Impact
  • Support the coordination of trade shows and customer events by assisting with logistics, booth materials, and on-site setup under the guidance of our event leads
  • Learn to process event leads into our CRM effectively so Sales can follow up, and help gather event results to support future planning
  • Contribute to ANYbotics' voice in the industrial and robotics community by helping to draft content and support our weekly social calendar
  • Assist in transforming articles, case studies, and webinars into engaging social posts that highlight the people and robots behind ANYbotics
  • Help map our existing content by industry and buyer stage to identify gaps, and participate in testing email journeys to keep our CRM data clean
  • Monitor competitors, press coverage, and industry awards to help keep the marketing team informed
  • Support the sourcing and inventory management of branded materials and merchandise, learning how to balance cost and quality
  • Collaborate on producing the newsletter, refreshing website pages, and organizing a centralized, self-serve library of digital marketing assets
  • Explore and help implement AI agents and automated workflows that assist the team with event reporting and content drafts
  • Review marketing tools and processes alongside the team, helping to document best practices so the whole department can use them

    • Your Profile
  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Bachelor's or Master's program in marketing, communications, business, or a related field
  • Eligible for an internship in Switzerland
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to help track multiple tasks, deadlines, and suppliers without dropping any
  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, comfortable learning new tasks and adapting to changing priorities
  • Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, take feedback constructively, and support cross-functional projects
  • Strong collaborative skills, eager to work closely with various teams within the Commercial division
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Hands-on attitude and willingness to travel to events, including assisting with the physical setup and carrying of booth materials

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with LinkedIn and other social platforms, ideally in a professional or academic setting
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Canva, or similar tools
  • Enthusiasm for experimenting with modern AI marketing tools
  • Interest in robotics, AI, or industrial technology

jobs.title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Switzerland.

We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment.
You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms.
The role combines hands-on engineering, data modelling, automation and production support.
You will collaborate with data analysts, reporting specialists and software developers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
This is an opportunity to apply modern cloud data engineering practices, improve data quality and contribute to the evolution of enterprise data solutions.


Accountabilities

  • Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.

  • Build, optimise and maintain data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.

  • Develop and manage data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, and organise data assets through Unity Catalog.

  • Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models to improve processing efficiency and data accessibility.

  • Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON.

  • Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes, debug issues and troubleshoot production pipelines to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

  • Apply Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices to manage development, testing, deployment and promotion of data solutions across environments.

  • Work closely with data analysts, reporting teams and software developers to understand business requirements and deliver appropriate technical solutions.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation and contribute to collaborative Agile delivery.

    • Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.

  • At least 8 years of professional IT experience, including 4 or more years in Data Engineering or ETL Development.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including:

  • PySpark and Spark SQL.

  • Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.

  • Databricks Workflows and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines.

  • Advanced SQL skills, including T-SQL and Spark SQL, with experience in Microsoft SQL Server, dimensional modelling and data warehousing.

  • Solid Python programming and scripting skills for data transformation, automation and pipeline development.

  • Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and data formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON, as well as ingestion from APIs and files.

  • Practical knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD, including automated testing and deployment processes.

  • Strong understanding of data integration, ETL development, data quality and production troubleshooting.

  • Ability to interpret complex business requirements, communicate technical solutions clearly and produce comprehensive documentation.

  • Strong organisational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in an Agile environment.

  • Fluent English and availability for occasional travel at the beginning of the project and when required.

  • Must be based in Europe and have the legal right to work in Europe, as work permit sponsorship is not provided.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow or Azure Functions for orchestration and event-driven processing.

  • Knowledge of dbt, PowerShell, .NET or Java.

  • Experience integrating data from SharePoint and Microsoft Graph.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, data governance, observability, Infrastructure as Code and data lineage.

  • Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot to improve development productivity.

    • Benefits

  • Fully remote working arrangement for candidates based in Europe.

  • Opportunity to work with a broad Azure data technology stack, including Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake and enterprise data warehousing.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in Switzerland.

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee accounting operations and lead financial integration across a growing international group of software businesses. You will manage the General Ledger (GL) team while taking ownership of accounting processes for newly acquired entities, from financial due diligence through post-merger integration. Working closely with senior finance leadership, M&A specialists, external auditors, tax advisors, and business stakeholders, you will ensure accurate financial reporting and effective multi-GAAP consolidation. You will play a central role in strengthening accounting structures, improving financial controls, and supporting the group's continued international expansion. This position offers the opportunity to develop expertise in M&A accounting, statutory reporting, and multi-entity financial management. You will also drive innovation by introducing AI-powered tools and automation to make finance operations more efficient and scalable.


Accountabilities

  • M&A Due Diligence and Integration: Lead the accounting workstream for potential acquisitions, conducting financial due diligence and managing post-merger integration activities, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation support, and fair-value adjustments.

  • NetSuite Implementation and Onboarding: Manage the integration of newly acquired businesses into NetSuite, designing and configuring their chart of accounts, reporting dimensions, and accounting structures to ensure seamless financial onboarding.

  • Financial Consolidation and Multi-GAAP Reporting: Oversee consolidation for newly acquired entities and manage multi-book reporting across different accounting standards, ensuring alignment between group reporting and local statutory GAAP requirements. Handle intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and reporting adjustments.

  • General Ledger and Month-End Close: Lead the GL function and ensure accurate, timely, and consistent month-end closing processes across multiple international entities.

  • Entity Accounting and Tax Compliance: Oversee accounting and statutory reporting for European, Canadian, and US entities, coordinating with external tax advisors to ensure compliance with local tax regulations and reporting obligations.

  • Statutory Audit Management: Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating and managing statutory audits, particularly across European and Canadian entities.

  • Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop the GL team, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Process Optimization and Automation: Review existing accounting and consolidation workflows, implement scalable financial controls, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and practical applications of AI tools.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the CFO, Director of Accounting and Tax, M&A and Controlling teams, external advisors, and portfolio company leadership to support financial integration and strategic decision-making.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite is essential, including designing accounting structures and onboarding new businesses or legal entities into the platform.

  • Experience working within SaaS, software, or technology companies, ideally in a complex multi-entity international structure.

  • Strong knowledge of financial consolidation and multi-GAAP reporting, including the ability to manage group reporting alongside local statutory accounting requirements.

  • Experience overseeing month-end closing, statutory reporting, and tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Audit Senior Specialist

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.

This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

You'll be responsible for

  • Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

  • Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks.

  • Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.

  • Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks.

  • Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks.

  • Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting.

  • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

  • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

  • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

  • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

We are looking for a person who has

Experience and background

  • A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience.

  • Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework.

  • Meaningful experience in fintech or banking.

  • Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees.

  • Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure.

Ways of working and skills

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • A genuinely hands-on posture

  • A builder mindset

  • A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential.

Cultural openness and humility

  • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives.

  • Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense.

  • German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). As a Strategy Intern, you will support the Strategy team in shaping and executing key strategic initiatives across the business.

During this internship, you will work closely with experienced strategy professionals and collaborate with stakeholders across development, commercial, and corporate teams. You will contribute to strategic analyses, support business planning cycles, and help drive initiatives that improve how the company operates. This role offers exposure to corporate strategy, commercial strategy, and business improvement initiatives in a purpose-driven organization.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Strategy support: Assist in developing and refining corporate and commercial strategies.

  • Market & business analysis: Conduct market research, competitive analyses, and business case assessments.

  • Commercial strategy projects: Support projects focused on areas such as sourcing, product development, partnerships, and market expansion.

  • Data analysis: Assist in building financial models, analyzing commercial performance, and supporting data-driven insights.

  • Workshops & stakeholder alignment: Help prepare materials for strategic discussions, workshops, and presentations for internal stakeholders and leadership.

  • Business improvement initiatives: Support projects aimed at improving processes, frameworks, and internal ways of working.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s student in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Strategy, Sustainability, Energy, or a related field (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

  • Strong interest in strategy, consulting, and business improvement

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

  • Comfortable working with Excel and PowerPoint; experience with financial modelling or data analysis is a plus

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills

  • Proactive, structured, and able to manage multiple topics simultaneously

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work with diverse stakeholders

  • Professional level of English, both written and spoken

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship from 15th of February 2027 onwards

  • Strong interest in our company, energy transition and building a more sustainable aviation industry

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • A monthly internship allowance of 800 euros.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Free Daily Lunch

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.

That's where you come in.

As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR), you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.

It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

  • Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

  • Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

  • Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

  • Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan.

  • Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Improve how we engage with leads

  • Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best.

  • Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data.

How we'll measure success

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention.

  • Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives.

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit:

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling.

  • RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking.

  • Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working.

What you’ll bring

  • 1-2 years of experience, ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus.

  • Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met.

  • A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you?

This is what we carefully prepared for you:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

  • 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad.

  • 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success.

  • 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp).

  • 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences.

  • 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel

  • 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ.

  • 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected.

  • 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues.

  • 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office.

  • 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future.

  • 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world.

🔍 Our hiring process

  1. Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team.

  2. Manager interview – Deep dive into experience and expectations.

  3. Practical assignment – Role-related, real-world challenge.

  4. Team connection – Meet future colleagues and confirm mutual fit.

We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Your next challenge starts here!

Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team.

👉 Apply today and let’s grow together!

We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Warehouse Executive (Netherlands) - Entry Level/No Experience Required
jobs.description:
Important Information

This role is a full time, 100% in office, entry-level position. No experience is required.

Working hours: M-F, 10AM - 6:30PM

Location: Oude Meer, North Holland, 1438 BC

Contract: 6 month FTC

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. Our DNA centers on understanding our customers' needs and offering them a seamless experience. With a growing team based in major cities worldwide, including London, New York, Hong Kong, and Mumbai, Nivoda is becoming the go-to marketplace for the global jewelry industry.

We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition.

The Role

You'll be a key player in a tight-knit team. Working alongside highly experienced logistics professionals at one of our largest international hubs, you'll handle and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments with precision and care.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous.

If you're looking for a fast-paced, highly supportive environment where your attention to detail and reliability will truly shine—this is your moment.

What you'll do

  • Shipment Handling & Repacking:

    Accurately handle, inspect, and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments in accordance with company protocols and international shipping standards.

  • Operational Support:

    Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently

  • Precision & Security:

    Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role.

  • Team Collaboration:

    Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence.

  • Process Improvement:

    Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly.

  • Growth Mindset:

    Be proactive, reliable, and open to learning. This role offers strong internal growth potential for individuals who show initiative and dedication.

What you'll need for this entry-level role:

  • Strong Attention to Detail

  • Ability to repack/handle goods

  • Team-Oriented Mindset

  • Basic Administrative Skills

  • Trustworthiness & Discretion

Highly desirable

  • Experience working in high-security logistics environments, preferably with luxury goods, jewelry, or diamonds.

  • Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures.

  • Proficiency in basic logistics software or ERP systems (e.g. SAP, NetSuite, or similar).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Physically fit and able to handle small manual tasks as part of the shipment handling process.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented attitude with a willingness to grow within a fast-scaling organization.

What you'll get:

💸Competitive compensation

🍎Free lunch

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

 

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international coming from across the world. We kindly ask you to please submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

This is a full time position that's 100% on-site in Oude Meer. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.


*If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we’d encourage you to join our Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.
You can sign up here: Nivoda Talent Pool

This ensures you're among the first to hear about openings aligned with your skills and interests.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

 

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

 

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

 

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Axelera AI is a fast-growing AI semiconductor company headquartered in Eindhoven, building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration hardware and software, from the Metis AI platform for edge inference to next-generation AI processing units. We are scaling quickly: new customers, new partners, new markets, and a growing volume of complex commercial deals across the global semiconductor supply chain.

We are looking for an experienced commercial lawyer to be the engine of our commercial legal function. You will close deals, build the playbooks and processes that let the business move fast without taking on unmanaged risk, and lead how legal operates day to day, with AI in the loop so a lean team delivers more with less. This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape the function as it grows.

Key responsibilities:

Commercial contracting

  • Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements: customer, distribution, reseller and OEM/ODM agreements; sales terms and EULAs; supply and manufacturing agreements (foundry, OSAT, component suppliers); technology and IP licences; software and SaaS agreements; evaluation, early access and development agreements; R&D collaboration and consortium agreements; services and vendor agreements; and MOUs, LOIs and partnership terms.

  • Act as the trusted, pragmatic adviser to Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations and Finance, giving clear, commercial risk calls at pace.

  • Advise on key semiconductor and AI issues: IP ownership and licensing, warranties and liability caps, product liability, export controls and sanctions, data protection and the EU AI Act.

  • Support the CFO and Head of Legal on strategic matters, including corporate transactions and board-level work, as needed.

Playbooks and scale

  • Build AI-ready contract playbooks, fallback positions and approval matrices so AI tools and the business can handle routine deals with minimal Legal involvement.

  • Create and own a library of standard templates for our core agreement types (e.g. NDA, customer terms, evaluation, distributor, supplier) aligned to our risk appetite.

  • Train commercial teams on contract basics, negotiation positions and when to escalate to Legal.

Legal operations

  • Lead legal operations: intake and triage, prioritisation, SLAs and reporting on legal workload and turnaround.

  • Own the legal tech and AI stack: select, implement and continuously improve AI review and drafting tools, CLM, e-signature and the contract repository, automating repeatable work end to end.

  • Own contract lifecycle management, including obligation tracking, renewals and keeping contract records complete and up to date.

  • Set up clear policies and processes that scale with the company.

Collaboration

  • Work alongside, supervise and mentor a Junior Legal Counsel, allocating work and reviewing output.

  • Manage external counsel efficiently, including scope and budget, and determine which matters are best handled in-house.

  • Report to the Head of Legal (in the interim, the CFO) and help shape the future structure of the legal team.

Qualifications:

Essential

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ years' PQE in commercial and corporate law, from a leading firm and/or in-house.

  • Substantial in-house experience in tech, semiconductors, hardware or deep tech, ideally at a scale-up.

  • A strong track record negotiating complex, high-value international contracts, including IP-heavy and supply chain deals.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in daily legal work, plus experience building playbooks and processes that let a small team scale.

  • Commercial judgement that finds the route to yes, and the ability to explain risk simply to senior stakeholders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, high volume and shifting priorities.

  • Fluent business English, our working and contract language.

Desirable

  • Semiconductor, AI or embedded systems experience (foundry, licensing, OEM deals).

  • Knowledge of export controls (EU dual-use, US EAR), sanctions and the EU AI Act.

  • Experience implementing CLM or AI contract tools, prompting, or building no-code automations.

  • Experience mentoring junior lawyers, or exposure to venture-backed companies and governance.

  • Dutch or another European language.

How We Work: AI-First Legal
We're building a lean legal function, not scaling by headcount. AI handles first-pass review, redlining, drafting and research, while lawyers focus on judgement and negotiation. Routine work is self-serve through templates and AI-assisted workflows. We measure turnaround and outcomes, and we use AI responsibly, with human review and clear guardrails on confidentiality and accuracy.

Location
Hybrid, with 2 days per week in our Amsterdam or Eindhoven office.

What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Team Experience Lead
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Prosus is continuing to evolve its business, product and investment activities, with ambitious plans to build, scale and grow technology-driven businesses and products globally.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and resourceful Executive Assistant to provide high-quality executive and operational support to three senior leaders: the Chief Product Officer, the Head of Ventures, and the Director of Strategy & Operations. This is a varied and fast-paced role that sits close to the heart of the business. You will play an important part in enabling these leaders to operate effectively, ensuring their time and priorities are managed efficiently and that the day-to-day running of their respective areas is seamless.

You will take ownership of complex calendars, international travel, meeting preparation, stakeholder coordination and administrative processes, while anticipating needs, managing competing priorities and identifying opportunities to improve how things are done. Working across different teams and functions, you will build strong relationships throughout the organisation and act as a trusted point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who combines exceptional organisational skills with sound judgement, discretion and a hands-on approach. Someone who enjoys being one step ahead, takes pride in making things happen and thrives in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

What You Will Do

Executive & Business Support

  • Provide proactive, high-quality executive assistance to the Chief Product Officer, Head of Ventures, and Director of Strategy & Operations.

  • Manage complex and frequently changing calendars, prioritising meetings, resolving scheduling conflicts and ensuring leaders make the best use of their time.

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, detailed itineraries and visa requirements.

  • Manage meeting logistics, including scheduling, preparing agendas, coordinating pre-reads and ensuring relevant materials are available ahead of time.

  • Capture key actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure commitments and deliverables are progressing.

  • Act as a trusted first point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, handling requests with professionalism, sound judgement and discretion.

  • Proactively anticipate the needs of the executives, identifying potential scheduling conflicts, upcoming priorities and opportunities to improve efficiency.

  • Manage expenses, invoices, budget tracking and other administrative processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies.

  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

Stakeholder & Operational Coordination

  • Build strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders across Product, Ventures, Strategy & Operations and the wider Prosus organisation.

  • Coordinate leadership meetings, workshops, offsites and other business events, managing logistics and ensuring smooth execution.

  • Support the coordination of cross-functional initiatives, helping ensure meetings, communications and follow-up actions are organised and delivered effectively.

  • Assist with onboarding and administrative arrangements for new team members and other relevant stakeholders across the supported functions.

  • Coordinate with HR, Finance, IT, Workplace, Legal and other internal teams to resolve requests and ensure efficient day-to-day operations.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify administrative processes, improve ways of working and create greater efficiency for the executives and their teams.

  • Provide general operational support across the three functions, stepping in where needed to keep priorities moving and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Who You Are

You are a highly organised, proactive and solutions-oriented professional who enjoys working closely with senior leaders and making their lives easier.

You naturally think several steps ahead, have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. You know when to take initiative, when to escalate and how to exercise sound judgement without needing constant direction.

You are confident in engaging with senior stakeholders, build relationships easily and communicate clearly and professionally. You are equally comfortable managing the finer details of a complex travel itinerary as you are coordinating a senior leadership meeting or resolving an unexpected scheduling challenge.

Above all, you are dependable, discreet and take pride in delivering excellent support. You enjoy being behind the scenes, making things happen and creating the conditions for others to perform at their best.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience in an Executive Assistant, Senior Personal Assistant or Executive Business Partner role, ideally supporting multiple senior executives.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, international and complex business environment, preferably within technology, investment or a corporate organisation.

  • Exceptional organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex calendars and competing priorities.

  • Strong experience coordinating international travel, meetings, leadership events and other executive-level logistics.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with senior stakeholders and external partners.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset, with the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently and take ownership of tasks from start to finish.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while working at pace.

  • High levels of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential and sensitive information.

  • Comfortable working across different teams and functions, building relationships and navigating a complex organisational environment.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other relevant productivity and collaboration tools.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

jobs.description:
About the role

Electronics is a trillion-dollar industry that still runs on spreadsheets, email threads and part-search tabs. Luminovo is the AI platform that replaces them, and DACH is our home market, with 400+ customers worldwide.

As a BDR in our DACH team you are the engine behind our new pipeline. You find the procurement, supply chain and engineering leaders at electronics manufacturers who overpay for components or carry hidden supply risk, start the conversation, and hand our Account Executives meetings worth taking. We want you to build the outbound machine with us, not only run it.

This is the first step of a defined path: consistent target achievement gets you considered for promotion to a full-cycle Account Executive role.

Your performance objectives

Generate pipeline

  • Build and keep current a target list of OEM accounts in DACH (automotive suppliers, industrial equipment, medical devices), and map the decision-makers per account in engineering, procurement and supply chain, using Sales Navigator, Apollo and Clay.

  • Run multichannel outbound (email, phone, LinkedIn, events) that books discovery calls for our AEs: 4 in month 1, 8 in month 2 and 12 per month from month 3 (16 per month at Level 3). Source your first qualified opportunities from month 2 and reach 6 per month by month 4 (8 at Level 3).

Qualify with precision

  • Run cold calls and discovery conversations in German that find the pain behind the title: the current process, the cost of delay, who decides. Hand over each meeting with clean notes so the AE never starts from zero.

  • Complete the discovery and demo certifications in your first weeks and all Lumiversity courses by the end of month 3, so every meeting you hand over meets our qualified-opportunity bar.

  • Tell us fast which segments and messages convert.

Build an AI-powered outbound engine

  • Within your first 90 days, design and ship one automation or agent that improves your own outbound (account research, personalized first lines, lead scoring), and show the result: reply rate, hours saved or meetings booked.

  • Share what works with the team, so the next BDR starts with your playbook.

Grow toward Account Executive

  • Learn the product and the electronics supply chain well enough to start co-running discovery calls with an AE.

  • Own your numbers every week (activity, reply rate, meetings, acceptance) and bring market insights to sales, marketing and product.

Your potential growth path

  • Months 1–3: master the product and our ICP, launch your first sequences, book your first qualified meetings.

  • Months 4–9: hit your meeting target consistently, ship your own automation, start co-running discovery with AEs.

  • After the ramp: consistent target achievement gets you considered for promotion to full-cycle Account Executive, following our sales progression framework.

Your territory and work setup

DACH market. Discovery calls and outreach happen in German and the company works in English, so you need both at a professional level. Hybrid in Munich or Berlin, with three office days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events, costs covered.

Whom you'll be working with

  • Dasha, our BDR Lead, who coaches you day to day

  • Clifton, our VP Global Sales

  • Inga, our pioneer AE in the OEM market segment

  • Seba, one of our founders, supporting the OEM go-to-market team

  • Max, our Revenue Operations Team Lead, and his team

Why Luminovo

  • Measurable product impact: our procurement intelligence shows OEMs where they pay above market and which parts put production at risk

  • A clear, written path from BDR to Account Executive

  • AI is part of how we work, from our MCP integrations to the agents our own teams build

  • Psychological safety, honest feedback, an international and remote-first team

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 400 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.
